^readit_NatHal04	R.B.Doogan	R.B.Doogan						R.B.Doogan
^readit_NatHal05	At the very beginning, the balance control strategy for biped robot is "static walking". \nThe special thing about this strategy is that the projection of the center of gravity is always on the polygon support area while the robot's walking. The advantage of this control strategy is that the robot can stop walking without falling over, but at the cost of being very slow.\nLater, another walking balance strategy called "dynamic walking" was developed. In dynamic walking, the robot's movement speed is increased to no more than 1 second per step. But the disadvantage is that the robot can't stop immediately while in motion, which makes the robot unstable during the process of state transition.\nZero Moment Point (ZMP) was introduced to deal with the impact of habits. \nThe advantage of introducing ZMP is that the robot will never fall if it is restricted to just the support area.\nThe above is a quick overview of the history. ^110008_report_1212		No.01 强度I						
^110008_report_1213		测试内容：将实验样本的时间感知进行超限调整，将外部世界的1秒提升为实验样本可感知的9999年时间，观察其在长时间下独立运作所产生的情感。

^110008_report_1216		测试内容：令实验样本在虚拟实验环境（实验样本未被告知此信息）切割清醒状态的人类躯体。

^110008_report_1218		No.02 强度II

^110008_report_1220		测试结果：实验样本在过程中产生道德感，无法对孕妇、幼儿等进行处决，2728次处决中失败达2022次。
